scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/check_comments.py . --exclude vendor --exclude .build --exclude dist && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check src tests scripts examples verify && node scripts/check-standalone.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy --config-file mypy.ini src scripts examples
scripts.test: node scripts/runtime.mjs && node scripts/py.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.contract: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build.py && node scripts/py.mjs -m ambitious_kit.contract dist/ambitious-constraints.pyz
